title: Second TTS backend is selected per job
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Pluggable TTS backends
  Scenario: Qwen backend selected by job metadata
    Given a job with tts_backend=qwen
    When a worker generates audio
    Then the Qwen TTSBackend implementation is used
```

## Implementation brief
1. Add cli and worker-image tts/qwen.py implementing TTSBackend.
2. Registry selects by job.tts_backend.
3. BDD/feature + unit test with fake backends.
right_now_summary: The issue calls for adding a Qwen TTS backend and selecting it from each job’s metadata.
